magic_shield.name: Shield
description: Friendly target of the spell add 2 to their
Protection value for each rank in 'Wizard'.
May only be cast once on each target.

resistance.name: Resistance
description: Friendly target of the spell add 2 to their
Resistance value for each rank in 'Wizard'.
May only be cast once on each target.

teleportation.name: Teleportation
description: Caster teleports to a chosen point on the battlefield.
